edge_labels: Trojanizes SolarWinds Orion business software updates to distribute SUNBURST via supply chain compromise
Signs and publishes digitally signed installer patch (March-May 2020)
Packages trojanized component SolarWinds.Orion.Core.BusinessLayer.dll
Downloaded and installed by administrators from updates website
Triggers execution of Orion software host framework
Loads digitally signed DLL into host process
Calls OrionImprovementBusinessLayer.Initialize via InventoryManager
Checks process name hash, assembly age threshold (12-14 days), and named pipe guard
Discovers analysis/AV processes, sets registry to disable services, checks drivers
Attempts to resolve api.solarwinds.com to test network connectivity if blocklist tests pass
Starts generating DGA subdomains in a while loop once connectivity and blocklist checks pass
Queries DNS, checks A-records against IP blocklists, retrieves CNAME record
Initializes HttpHelper C2 thread mimicking Orion Improvement Program (OIP)
Extracts steganographic commands from GUID/HEX strings to execute Jobs
Deploys TEARDROP memory-only dropper in at least one instance (samples delivered different payloads)
Decodes rolling XOR payload from fake JPG file; believed to execute customized Cobalt Strike BEACON
Sets C2 hostnames matching victim environment and uses victim-country VPS IPs to evade detection
Maintains light malware footprint, using compromised credentials for remote access and distinct credentials for lateral movement
Uses temporary file replacement and scheduled task modification to remotely execute utilities and evades detection by removing tools
Facilitates lateral movement across victim networks leading to data theft
